title: Image URLs work in Vertex AI vision requests
summary:
Two text API fixes make image-URL vision requests work with Vertex AI and stop OpenAI-compatible parameters from disappearing during parsing.

The text API now fetches HTTP image URLs and passes the images to Vertex AI models, including gemini-large, in a format they accept. The fetch rejects non-images and limits images to 20 MB.

Text API parsing now preserves max_tokens and max_completion_tokens instead of dropping them and leaving requests at the default 2,048-token cap.

Parsing also preserves stop, stream_options, logprobs, top_logprobs, logit_bias, n, and user for downstream model handling.
